name: outsystems-project-template
description: OutSystems design-system project: specs, token layer and audit, theme build, fidelity gate and one review Artifact per build. Behaviour lives in the outsystems-loop Claude Code plugin (4.x).

scripts.build:theme: npm run check:config && npm run check:stylesheets && npm run check:state && node build/build-theme.mjs && node build/validate-theme.mjs && node build/token-audit.mjs
scripts.build:theme:ship: npm run check:config && npm run check:stylesheets && npm run check:state && node build/build-theme.mjs --ship && node build/validate-theme.mjs && node build/token-audit.mjs
